title: Claude Code from Telegram, Discord or Slack: routes
h1: claude code from telegram, discord or slack
description: Compare a custom chat bridge with Claude Remote Control and Metal chat, and separate talking to a bot from posting into a team channel.
answer: **text your bot from the couch without turning slack into a remote terminal.** a custom bridge needs someone to handle who can direct it, how approvals return and which computer stays on. anthropic’s remote control and dusk’s own chats offer other routes.[^1][^2] most people asking for this just want to text their bot from the couch. that part needs no bridge.

review.by: lead agent: independent reviewer pass against seo/facts (4 reviewers), every finding applied, automated gate

og_line: three different reasons to connect a chat.

sections.h: what do you want the chat app to do?
sections.md:
**decide whether you want to talk to the bot or hear from it.** “claude code in slack” can mean very different jobs:

- control a session by sending a slack message
- let a bot read team discussion
- post a finished report into a channel

a posting action handles the last job. it does not give channel members control of the session. decide who may issue instructions before building that route. skip that and anyone in #general can tell your agent to run commands.

**a weekend bridge project with your github token in it is how accounts get emptied.** someone has to own more than the message box:

- **who:** which person or channel may issue requests?
- **context:** does a message continue a job or start another?
- **approval:** where do questions arrive, and how do answers return?
- **uptime:** which computer keeps the session running?
- **failure:** how do you spot a lost connection?

if you can’t answer those five questions, don’t build it.

sections.h: remote control keeps the session on your machine
sections.md:
**your phone is a window, not the computer doing the work.** as of 12 november 2026, remote control connects claude.ai/code or claude’s ios and android app to your local session.[^1]

the computer must stay on with claude running. this route does not use telegram, discord or slack. the [phone guide](/claude-code-from-your-phone) compares where the session lives.

sections.h: dusk gives each bot its own conversation
sections.md:
**want claude code in your pocket? text the bot from your phone.** pair once by scanning a code. paired with your computer, it works while that computer is on. paired with dusk cloud, it works with the laptop shut.[^3]

dusk keeps named bots with jobs, chats, memory and an ai choice for each. it runs official ai command-line apps where the bots live.[^2]

you talk in dusk. each bot has a conversation you can come back to, without another team-chat channel to maintain.

**put the finished report where your team already reads.** dusk’s slack actions include message search and sending. prepare the result in the bot’s chat, then name its channel. see the [slack integration](/integrations/slack).[^4]

sends ask first unless you allow a daily amount. careful with **Full access**: a bot there with no sending rule can send up to 25 a day without asking. give it **Ask every time**.[^8]

reading jobs can stay read only. other app edits do not automatically ask; tell a writer “ask me before you change anything”.[^5]

discord’s action list covers account and server membership, with no message-posting action as of 12 november 2026. the [discord connection](/integrations/discord) handles different jobs from slack.[^6]

sections.h: choose the route you can keep running
sections.md:
**use the smallest route that answers the actual need.** remote control suits a window into your running local session. dusk suits its own bot conversations and app connections.

a custom bridge makes sense when that chat entry point matters enough to maintain it. decide who will fix it after a broken connection.

use the [computer safety guide](/guides/is-it-safe-to-let-ai-control-your-computer) to limit what the session can reach. if the yes/no prompt doesn’t reach you, the bridge is broken. fix that first.

faq.q: is there an official telegram bridge for claude code?
faq.a: **we do not know of one.** anthropic’s published phone route is remote control.[^1]

faq.q: can i use a slack post to control a Metal bot?
faq.a: **you chat with the bot in dusk.** slack events can start a routine and arrive at once. the bot can post back, but slack does not become its chat interface.[^2][^4][^7]

faq.q: does the discord connection include posting messages?
faq.a: **the checked action list does not include it.** that is the discord catalog as of 12 november 2026.[^6]
